content.value_statement: Email teams often lose time aligning subject lines, body copy, claims, and landing pages. This skill produces a complete single-email draft with traceable claims, one CTA, plain text, and message-match notes.
actual_capabilities: Drafts three to five labeled subject-line variants and one matched preheader.
Applies distinct structures for promotional, cold-outbound, and newsletter emails.
Writes scannable body copy with one primary CTA and a plain-text alternate.
Traces marketing claims to approved wording and marks unsupported claims for sourcing.
Maps email promises, offers, and CTA labels to the destination page.
Saves a confirmed draft to a scoped memory path with dependency details.
limitations: It does not send email or authorize a campaign send.
It does not rank subject lines, score email quality, or compute EQS.
It does not design multi-step sequences or complete experiment plans.
It needs an offer, audience, mode, and destination URL for reliable message matching.

use_cases.title: Launch a lifecycle promotion
use_cases.description: Create a complete promotional email that matches approved offer terms and the destination page.

use_cases.title: Draft verified cold outreach
use_cases.description: Write a concise relevance-first email using a genuine personalization signal and a low-pressure reply request.

use_cases.title: Prepare a sponsored newsletter
use_cases.description: Build editorial copy with a clearly disclosed sponsor section and one primary reader action.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a promotional email
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft one promotional email for [offer] at [URL]. Include five subject lines, a preheader, body copy, one CTA, and plain text.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start a single B2C promotion from a confirmed offer and landing page.

prompt_templates.title: Create cold outreach
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a cold-outbound email for [persona] using [verified signal]. Seek a reply, avoid fabricated familiarity, and flag every unsupported claim.
prompt_templates.scenario: Contact a business prospect with verified personalization and a low-friction request.

prompt_templates.title: Build a sponsored newsletter
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a newsletter for [topic] and [URL] with one sponsor section. Separate editorial content, disclose sponsorship, and map each promise to the page.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare a creator newsletter that keeps paid content distinct from editorial content.

prompt_templates.title: Iterate with campaign evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Using [past results] and [existing copy], replace weak subject lines while holding the preheader, body, CTA, and send time constant. Label variants.
prompt_templates.scenario: Develop controlled subject-line variants from previous campaign performance.

output_examples.input: Create a promotional email for 20 percent off annual plans through Friday.
output: Subject A: Save 20 percent on your annual plan
Subject B: Your annual plan offer ends Friday
Preheader: Choose an annual plan before the confirmed offer closes.
Body: Move to an annual plan and apply the confirmed 20 percent offer before Friday. CTA: View annual plans.
Plain text: Save 20 percent on an annual plan through Friday. View annual plans at the confirmed destination.

output_examples.input: Draft a cold email to operations leaders who still export weekly reports manually.
output: Subject A: Still exporting weekly reports by hand?
Subject B: A simpler weekly reporting workflow
Preheader: Reduce repetitive reporting work with a verified workflow.
Body: I noticed your team uses manual weekly exports. If that signal is verified, would a short workflow review be useful?
Claim note: Keep the observation flagged until its source is confirmed.

best_practices: Provide the exact offer, audience, email mode, brand voice, and destination URL.
Confirm every statistic, price, guarantee, discount, testimonial, and personalization signal before use.
Review message matching, disclosures, plain text, and claim flags before handing the draft to an auditor.
anti_patterns: Do not request a ready-to-send draft when the destination URL or offer terms are missing.
Do not treat generated subject variants as ranked winners without a separate evaluation.
Do not remove unsupported-claim flags or convert estimates into facts.

faq.question: Can this skill send the finished email?
faq.answer: No. It drafts creative only, and sending requires separate approval and suppression checks.

faq.question: Which email formats does it support?
faq.answer: It supports promotional and lifecycle email, B2B cold outreach, and creator newsletters.

faq.question: Does it test or rank subject lines?
faq.answer: No. It drafts labeled variants for later scoring or controlled testing by another workflow.

faq.question: What happens when a claim lacks evidence?
faq.answer: The skill keeps a visible needs-source flag and blocks ready-to-send status for material unresolved claims.

faq.question: Why is a destination URL required?
faq.answer: The URL lets the skill verify that each email promise, offer, and CTA matches the landing page.

faq.question: Can it use past campaign data?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use a user-provided ESP export to identify useful angles without requiring a keyed API.
